name: Semantic Distance Masking via Set Union
description: Replaces the explicit equality/inequality constraint with a logically equivalent set-union condition: two 3-element subsets of a 4-element set union to the whole set if and only if they are distinct. This prevents models from immediately pattern-matching to graph coloring, forcing them to either explicitly model the sets (which is prone to implementation error and inefficiency) or genuinely deduce the underlying inequality constraint.
